description: The Globus Search content fields of one session entry and their FROZEN types. Globus Search fixes a field's type the first time it sees it, so a type here never changes; a later version only adds fields. Every exported entry is checked against this list: an unknown field, or a value of another type, stops the export. No field is ever named after a data value (label counts are a list of {label, count}). null and empty values are left out.

types.text: a JSON string meant for full-text search
types.string_list: a JSON array of strings (never empty)
types.object_list: a JSON array of objects whose keys and types are given in 'fields' (never empty)
types.date: UTC to the second with Z, e.g. 2026-11-17T03:50:15Z

title.description: The session folder; the teammate's catalog app shows it as the title.

path.description: Path below the project root, e.g. raw/raman-portable/simulated/<folder>.

collection_id.description: The Globus collection that holds the data (ARC Projects).

data_path.description: The folder's path inside that collection, e.g. /pcl_photonics/raw/...

web_url.description: The folder in the Globus web app file manager.

operator.description: Only when the settings say include_operator true.

notes.description: Only when the settings say include_notes true.

labels.description: The effective labels of the current classify run (a point whose newest review rejected it has no label).

label_counts.description: How many points of the current run have each effective label.

models.description: The models that have a classify run of the session.

problems.description: Problem codes the last build found for the session.

verified.description: When the session's newest fixity check passed; left out when that check FAILED or there was none.
